name: EPA SDWIS Drinking Water Data Downloads
known_limitations: Download tables reflect state and federal reporting within defined periods and fields; records can lag, change, or require joining multiple files and do not establish present local service capacity.
automation_notes: Preserve download vintage, table and field definitions, public-water-system identifier, reporting period, violation and enforcement identifiers, and join rules.
notes: National drinking-water system and compliance download rail; not a capacity record.
